title: A Unified Forward Error Correction Accelerator for Multi-Mode Turbo, LDPC, and Polar Decoding
key_contribution: Unified architecture for Turbo/LDPC/Polar decoding demonstrating that belief-propagation-style iterative refinement can be efficiently implemented across diverse code structures.

title: High-throughput software LDPC decoder on GPU
venue: EURASIP Journal on Advances in Signal Processing
key_contribution: Demonstrated 27.6 Gbps LDPC decoding throughput on GPU using forward/backward belief propagation, proving that iterative decode-then-validate patterns can achieve high throughput.

title: Base64 Malleability in Practice
key_contribution: Demonstrated real-world security impact of non-strict Base64 validation, motivating the need for efficient but thorough validation schemes.
